title: TerraPing
blurb: A battery-powered soil sensor I'm prototyping on the nRF54L15-DK, aimed at native HomeKit, Google Home, and Alexa support over Matter. Currently on hold.

title: Gracie
blurb: A mecanum-wheel robot with a 3D camera and robotic arm, built for precise pick-and-place. Hardware's done; I'm still working through the software.

title: FloraByte
blurb: A countertop hydroponics system I built into an old AeroGarden shell, with automated pH/EC dosing and a Home Assistant dashboard.

title: RoboRover
blurb: A ROS2 robot I built from scratch on a Jetson Orin Nano to learn SLAM, navigation, and teleop. The project that led directly to Gracie.

title: AquaCore
blurb: My first hydroponics controller — a TM4C123 board automating light height and reservoir level. The proof of concept that became FloraByte.

title: HiveMind
blurb: A Python solver for the multi-agent traveling salesman problem, using k-means clustering and 2-opt routing to split work across agents.

title: VaporIQ
blurb: A gas density monitor I built on the Tiva C LaunchPad, modeled after the SF6 monitoring used in real high-voltage circuit breakers.

title: EchoLux
blurb: An LED strip that reacts to live audio in real time, built on a PyBoard running MicroPython.
